title: Actix Web
notes: Actix Web's router and JSON helper with Tera templates, on its default worker threads. Release build, no middleware.
details: Actix Web's router, web::Path and web::Data extractors and web::Json responder; pages are Tera templates (with inheritance and a price filter) parsed once at start and shared as application data, as in the templating example of actix/examples, and escaped by Tera (built with its recommended `fast` feature). /about is rendered from its template on each request: Actix Web has no build-time prerendering. No middleware is added (no Logger, no Compress, as in a new application). Actix's default server: one process, one single-threaded worker per core. Built with cargo build --release at Cargo's default optimization settings and run as one process with Actix's default worker count, so idle workers cost some CPU under a light load. Cargo cannot skip build scripts or procedural macros, so those of the locked crates run at build time, as for every Rust entry here.
